field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disabled hosts are kept in the list but are not checked and not shown on the status page.

field.label: Display name
field.help: Unique name shown on the status page (1-64 characters).

field.label: Address
field.help: IPv4, IPv6 or hostname, optionally with a port for reference only (the port is never probed). Examples: 192.168.1.10, 192.168.1.10:8006, pve.lan:8006, fe80::1, [2001:db8::1]:8006.

field.label: Group
field.help: Network, Nodes and Apps are shown first, in that order. Any other group follows, sorted A-Z.

field.label: Sort order
field.help: Integer from -9999 to 9999 (default 0). Lower first, ties sorted by name.
